stories.title: University of Chester nursing graduate from Deeside praised by lecturers
stories.summary: A mother of four from Aston has qualified as a nurse with a first-class degree from the University of Chester, after studying while running the family home. stories.title: Flintshire temperatures forecast to reach 30C on Wednesday
stories.summary: Temperatures in Flintshire are forecast to reach 30C on Wednesday, the hottest day of a week of building heat across England and Wales. stories.title: Bryn Williams team to run new daytime café at Theatr Clwyd
stories.summary: A daytime café will open at Theatr Clwyd in Mold on Monday 24 August, run by the team behind the venue’s Bryn Williams restaurant.
